dependency_contracts.contract: Dyson auth supplies CurrentUser; authentication, authorization and RemotePermissionMiddleware precede controller dispatch. Preserve per-action AskPermission, member-role and current-user checks. No authorization implementation in port.

FilterWithVisibility requires current user, friend IDs, owned publishers, listing mode, gatekept publisher IDs, active accepted nonblocking subscriber IDs and close-friend publisher IDs. Timeline also resolves blocked/muted accounts/publishers, public/user realms, federation visibility and boosts before ranking.

dependency_contracts.contract: Non-latest ranking uses AutomodService penalty/hide and post/publisher shadowban-for-listing maps. Latest returns early after direct post/publisher shadowban filtering. Federation has separate inbox validation/rate-limit/parsing and moderation services.
